anthropic.description: Claude Opus for narrative + Gemini images. Premium storytelling quality.

veo.description: Video-based image generation - generates 8s videos, extracts last frame. Natural consistency!

krea.description: Krea 2 Medium images (~12s, style transfer for continuity) + Gemini narrative. Higher fidelity. Requires KREA_API_KEY.

krea_large.description: Krea 2 Large images (~24s, higher quality) + Gemini narrative. Requires KREA_API_KEY.

fal.description: DEFAULT hybrid: Krea for the establishing still (frame 0), fal SDXL Lightning for fast updates. Needs KREA_API_KEY + FAL_API_KEY.

description: Hybrid default: Krea establishes frame 0, fal Lightning paints follow-up updates. Switch to krea/krea_large for full quality, or gemini/openai/veo via /ai_switch.
